root_cause.text: The function trigger_data_free() lacks a NULL pointer check, so when trigger_data_alloc() fails and returns NULL, the error path in event_hist_trigger_parse() calls trigger_data_free(NULL), leading to a NULL pointer dereference when accessing data->cmd_ops.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states: "If trigger_data_alloc() fails and returns NULL, event_hist_trigger_parse() jumps to the out_free error path. ... trigger_data_free() does not. This causes a NULL pointer dereference in trigger_data_free() when evaluating data->cmd_ops->set_filter." The patch adds `if (!data) return;` at the start of trigger_data_free() to fix this.
